title: NFL Player Ed Oliver's Toddler Son Dies in Incident
summary: The two-year-old son of Buffalo Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver has died. The NFL team announced the death, with general manager Brandon Beane calling it an "unthinkable tragedy for any parent." The incident was reportedly a drowning. Oliver is mourning the loss of his son.
summary_points: Buffalo Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver's two-year-old son has died.
The NFL team confirmed the death.
General manager Brandon Beane described the event as an "unthinkable tragedy."
The incident was reportedly a drowning.
